about: Shared test cases for the battle map layout checks (knowledge/domain/battle-map.md, "Layout document").
The editor (src/web/src/editor/validation.ts) runs them now; the server runs the same file from stage 6 on.
Each case is a map and the problem codes the checks must report for it, in any order, each as often as listed.
Defaults for fields a case leaves out: name "Testkarte"; scene, vibe and lighting ""; layout.schemaVersion 1; layout.cells, features and entrances [].

cases.name: a map with a fractional width
a lighting of 500 characters with spaces around
a room with listed void, wall, water and difficult cells
a cell right of the grid
a cell with a fractional coordinate
a cell elevation at the limit
a cell elevation at the negative limit
a feature filling the whole grid
a feature with a fractional height
a feature sticking out on the right
a feature sticking out at the bottom
two features with the same id
a feature with a blank kind
a feature elevation at the negative limit
an entrance on the left edge
an entrance on a bridge over void at the edge
an entrance on water and difficult terrain
an entrance under a blocking feature
an entrance cell inside the map
an entrance cell left inside the map after a resize, on void
an entrance cell outside the grid
an entrance cell with one coordinate
an entrance listing a cell twice
two entrances with the same id
a map size out of range skips the position checks
every problem is reported, not only the first
